sentences.text:
Swapan Kumar Ghosh vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors on 12
June, 2024

Author: Amrita Sinha
Bench: Amrita Sinha

Court No. 14
 Agm
 In The High Court At Calcutta
 Constitutional Writ Jurisdiction
 Appellate Side
 W.P.A 27571 of 2023
 Swapan Kumar Ghosh
 -versus
 The State of West Bengal & Ors.
 Mr. Anirban Dutta.
 Ms. Priyanka Mukherjee.
... For the petitioner.

Mr. Sk. Md. Galib.
 Mr. Abu Siddique Mallik.
...For the State.
Mr. Soubhik Mitter.
Ms. Rajnandini Das.
... for the Private
respondent nos. 5 to 7.
The petitioner is a septuagenarian widower.

The respondent no. 5 is the daughter-in-law,
respondent no. 6 is the son and the respondent no. 7 is the mother of the respondent no. 5.
Allegation of the petitioner is that the son and daughter-in-law have forcefully driven him out from his own residence.
The son has also taken away the ATM Card of the petitioner who is a pensioner and he is regularly withdrawing money from the pension account without the consent and information of the petitioner.
Several complaints were lodged before the police but the police is not taking any action in response to the same.

sentences.text: It has been submitted that the daughter-in-law lodged a complaint before the Police Station and the police registered an FIR under Sections 498A/376/511/354/506/406 IPC.
The petitioner right now is compelled to reside in a rented accommodation.

Learned advocate representing the private respondents submits, upon instruction that, the petitioner voluntarily moved out from the subject premises and, accordingly, a complaint was lodged before the police.
It has been submitted that the petitioner also tried to commit rape upon the respondent no. 5.
It has been further submitted that the petitioner is in touch with various other women of the locality.

In support of the said submission, learned advocate for the private respondents seeks to produce before this Court photographs which the private respondents collected from the mobile phone of the petitioner.
As the house in question is recorded in the name of the petitioner, he has every right to reside over there.
The private respondents ought not to be bothered by any private connection/communication made by the petitioner with whoever he wants to.

As the private respondent no. 5 has raised an allegation of attempt to cause rape by the petitioner,
accordingly, it may not be proper for the private respondent no. 5 to reside in the same place as that of the petitioner.
The private respondent nos. 5 and 6 ought to find out an alternative accommodation to move out and let the petitioner reside peacefully in his own house at the fag end of his life.
Let the matter appear in the list on 19.06.2024.

Learned advocate representing the private respondents shall file an undertaking by way of an affidavit disclosing the time within which they would vacate the subject premises so that the petitioner may be put back in his own house.
The ATM Card of the petitioner shall positively be brought to this Court on the adjourned date.
The private respondents are restrained from withdrawing any sum from the bank account of the petitioner.
All parties to act on the basis of the server copy of this order downloaded from the official website of this Court.

( Amrita Sinha, J.)
